description: Agent Healthcare: submit a prior authorization with the order as written: the authorization with its number, status (approved, partially approved, pending or denied), the service as authorized, the codes as authorized, the visits or units authorized, the dates it is valid from and through, the site of service as authorized (office, outpatient hospital, inpatient hospital, ambulatory surgery center, imaging center, laboratory, home, telehealth or other) and the provider; the order with the day ordered, the service as ordered, the codes, the visits or units ordered, the day the service is planned, the site of service and the provider. The signed report gives the authorization, the order with its service read as matching or differing, the ordered codes the authorization does not list and the authorized codes the order does not name, the visits or units on each side, the planned day against the validity dates, and the site on each side, and counts them, and names a mismatched authorization: an authorization that reads denied or pending, an ordered code it does not list, more visits or units ordered than authorized, a planned day outside the validity dates and a site of service unlike the order; then an authorized code the order does not name, a service named otherwise and a provider unlike the order, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No status, codes missing on either side, ordered units the authorization does not state, no validity dates, validity dates with no planned day, or a site on one side only leaves the authorization unverified. Validity that ends before it starts is refused. Codes match by their letters and digits. This reads the authorization paperwork against the order: wever_delegation-check reads an agent’s own delegation or mandate for its grantee, scope, caps and expiry, not a care authorization, and wever_insurance-coverage-check reads whether a policy covers an activity, which the authorization check never weighs: it reads what the authorization states against what the order states. Verdict health_authorization_mismatched, health_authorization_partial, health_authorization_unverified or health_authorization_aligned. POST /api/health-authorization-check. Reads the care paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads paperwork consistency only, with no diagnosis, clinical reading of results, medical necessity judgment or treatment advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Healthcare reads supplied care paperwork after the fact and checks it for consistency against the related records and the summary given to the patient or principal: an itemized bill, a claim as submitted, a prior authorization, a referral, a prescription record and label, a discharge summary, a lab report and an after-visit summary. Beside it, the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies and coverage, what a policy covers, excludes and limits, and where the question is what a policy covers, that is the insurance family’s read, not a healthcare check’s; wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt for DiligenceOps; wever_callback-health-monitor probes a service’s HTTPS callback endpoint for uptime and reads no care document; and the Agent Consent checks such as wever_consent-scope-check read agent permission and consent records for data handling, not medical consent forms or care documents, while a healthcare check reads no agent permission. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-healthcare-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-healthcare/.
